goat.formula: GOAT score = 40% career production (PTS 40%, REB 15%, AST 15%, STL 10%, BLK 10%, 3PM 10% of the component, each career total vs the window's best) + 35% award-race resume (top-10 finishes are worth 11-rank points, race MVP ×1.0, DPOY ×0.8, 6th ×0.5, MIP ×0.4) + 25% peak (best season's per-game impact), each component 0-100 vs the best player in the window; requires ≥82 career games in the collected seasons.
